transcript.text: I need to flag a critical privacy concern before we go further. I completed a privacy review thirty minutes ago and confirmed that the activity payloads include precise location data. This has two direct implications for the RFC: first, events must be tokenized before entering the event bus — direct protobuf publishing without tokenization would expose precise location data to any consumer or replay worker. Second, the storage must be in the EU region, not the default US region as the draft currently proposes. I haven't filed the review record yet, but these are hard requirements that need to be reflected in the architecture before I can give privacy sign-off.
